title: That Young Person From Before
description:
A call from the business owner whose wallet was returned — months later.
"How have you been? I kept thinking about what you did.
As it happens I need someone I can trust — could you help out at the shop on weekends?
I'll pay well. I want an honest person."

An honest pair of hands brought an unexpected opening.

choices.text: Say yes.  (income + connection / weekends + rest gone)
choices.result_text:
{name} showed up at the owner's shop every weekend. The pay was decent, and so was the learning.
The owner shared everything — how to run a business, how to read people.
In exchange, weekends disappeared entirely.
But the connection built on honesty — it was becoming something solid.

choices.text: Decline, with thanks.  (freedom + rest / opportunity + connection)
choices.result_text:
"I'll receive the thought. I want to build my own foundation first."
The owner was sorry but nodded. "Come by whenever."
{name} kept the weekends — and kept the pace.
But that unextended hand came to mind sometimes.

title: Surgical Consent
description:
Mom calls. Voice breaking.
"Your father... he collapsed. They say he needs surgery. Five million won, they said..."

{name}'s account comes to mind. The seed money built through years of grinding.
Drain it — and ₩3 billion goes impossibly far again.
But on the other side of the scale — Dad's life.

choices.text: Empty the account if that's what it takes.  (life + filial duty / goal pushed back)
choices.result_text:
{name} didn't hesitate. Emptied the account. Years rolled back in an instant.
The surgery went well. Dad held {name}'s hand for a long time.
"Sorry. I'm a burden again." "...No you're not, Dad."
Gangnam moved further away. But what couldn't be lost — {name} kept it.

choices.text: Can't do it. Send just a message.  (keep the goal / guilt + relationship)
choices.result_text:
{name} couldn't bring up the seed money. "I'm not in a position to..."
Mom said "it's okay, we'll manage" and hung up.
That night, {name} sat staring at the account balance for a long time.
Kept the goal. Bought a guilt that might last forever.

choices.text: Take a loan if needed. Find the money.  (filial duty + goal / debt's grip)
choices.result_text:
{name} kept the seed money intact and covered the hospital bill with a loan.
Saved Dad and protected the savings — but interest squeezes the neck every month.
Grew up watching Dad spend six years paying off his debts. Now {name} is on that same road.
Chasing two things at once always means putting something up as collateral.
